args.description: rearrange-panels-to-cat-silhouette: deterministic drawing.write tool. Input: existing drawing panel set (2,345 polylines). Behavior: reposition every panel's centroid (preserving each panel's size/shape/identity, no add/delete — count preserved exactly) into a sitting-cat silhouette composed of body, two ears, and a curved tail. Must be deterministic (same input -> same output layout every time). Must support a dry-run/preview mode returning the proposed new centroid layout without committing. Committing the write must create a new immutable drawing version. Must return a change_set_id for staging when run in build/preview mode.
